Maryland football is set to play its first road game under interim head coach Aazaar Abdul-Rahim against a Purdue team that has surged back after finishing bottom of the Big Ten last year. The game is set to kick at 12:30 p.m. EST Saturday in West Lafayette and will air on FS1.
 For your pregame entertainment, Testudo Times previewed the matchup against the Boilermakers , and the trio of football reporters hopped on a podcast to offer their predictions for the game as well.
